    </h2>

    </p>
    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.075rem; color: #2B2B2B; line-height: 1.75; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;">

A Christian school in Juba — built with local churches, community leaders, and organizations — gives children academic excellence and biblical truth in the same classroom. Phase 1 puts land, foundation, and the first classrooms in place, so teaching can begin as early as possible.
    </p>

    <blockquote style="margin: 2rem 0 0; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-left: 4px solid #D4A017; background: #F7F6F2;">

      </p>

  }
  @media (max-width: 560px) {

    .budget-row      { grid-template-columns: 1fr 120px !important; padding: 1rem 1rem !important; }
  }
  .campaign-cta-primary:hover   { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(212,160,23,0.5); }
  .campaign-cta-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
  details[open] summary { color: #D4A017; }
  details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  details summary::after { content: " +"; float: right; color: #D4A017; font-weight: 700; }
  details[open] summary::after { content: " −"; }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  // ── Live Stripe-powered progress tracker ──────────────────
  const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  const GOAL = 100000;

  const raisedEl  = document.getElementById('campaign-raised');
  const percentEl = document.getElementById('campaign-percent');
  const donorsEl  = document.getElementById('campaign-donors');
  const updatedEl = document.getElementById('campaign-updated');
  const barEl     = document.getElementById('campaign-bar');
  const progressBar = barEl && barEl.parentElement;

  function applyProgress(raised, donors, asOf) {
    const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((raised / GOAL) * 100));
    if (raisedEl)  raisedEl.textContent  = fmt.format(raised);
    if (percentEl) percentEl.textContent = pct + '%';
    if (donorsEl)  donorsEl.textContent  = donors + (donors === 1 ? ' donor' : ' donors');
    if (barEl)     barEl.style.width     = pct + '%';
    if (progressBar) progressBar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(raised));
    if (updatedEl && asOf) {
      const d = new Date(asOf);
      updatedEl.textContent = 'Updated ' + d.toLocaleString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
    }
  }

  function showFallback() {
    if (updatedEl) updatedEl.textContent = 'Live total temporarily unavailable';
  }

  fetch('/.netlify/functions/campaign-progress?campaign=2026', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
    .then(function(r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(r.status); })
    .then(function(data) {
      const raised = Number(data.raised) || 0;
      const donors = Number(data.donors) || 0;
      applyProgress(raised, donors, data.asOf || Date.now());
    })
    .catch(showFallback);
})();
</script>
